cover_prompt: Full-color vibrant illustration of a serene Japanese temple and zen garden scene. SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio). A beautiful wooden temple with curved multi-tiered roof sits beside a meticulously raked zen rock garden. Cherry blossom trees in full pink bloom frame the scene. A red torii gate stands at the entrance of a stone path. A tranquil koi pond with a graceful arched wooden bridge reflects the temple. Stone lanterns glow softly along the pathway. Bamboo grove rises in the background against misty mountains. Lush moss covers ancient stones. The scene radiates peace, harmony, and traditional Japanese beauty. Rich warm colors with soft golden light. Premium cozy aesthetic suitable for a coloring book cover. Text area reserved at top for title. Coloring Book for Adults.
